bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New builds released for Dev and Beta Channels enhance cross-device app usage.
My Apps Feature for Gamers - Xbox Insiders can now access games faster through the new 'My Apps' feature.
Leader in Cloud-Native Platforms - Microsoft recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms.
Quantum-Safe Security Initiatives - Microsoft is advancing towards next-generation cryptography to prepare for quantum computing threats.
Designing Multi-Agent Intelligence - New strategies for AI deployment focus on specialized, task-oriented agents for enterprise efficiency.
